newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Skanska, Securum set Pandox price at 52 Skr/share.
newsitem.headline: Skanska, Securum set Pandox price at 52 Skr/share.

text.p: Swedish construction group Skanska AB and state-owned company Securum AB said on Friday they had set the sales price of hotel property group Pandox Hotellfastigheter to 52 crowns a share.
The offering was subscribed about four times, Skanska and Securum said in a joint statement. The companies announced on March 18 that they would sell Pandox.
Pandox shares will start trading on the Stockholm Stock Exchange's O list on June 23.
Skanska sold 3.5 million shares in Pandox and Securum sold 4.5 million, totalling eight million shares which corresponds to 80 percent of the total number of shares and votes in Pandox.

"An additional one million shares, at the most, corresponding to 10 percent of the total number of shares and votes in Pandox, could be sold in conjunction with the offering if the over-allotment option is exercised," the companies said.
Pandox owns 16 Swedish hotel properties with a total book value 1.36 billion crowns and total annual rental revenues of 136 million crowns based on proforma calculations for 1996.
Securum was created to manage assets pledged for loans at Swedish bank Nordbanken during the banking crisis in the early nineties.
